claim: Even when incremental malware scanning is selected, AWS Backup performs a full scan if the baseline recovery point was scanned more than 365 days ago, because Amazon GuardDuty retains finding information for only 365 days.
question: When does an incremental malware scan fall back to a full scan because of an expired baseline?

values.spoken: more than three hundred sixty-five days ago

qualifiers.scope: incremental malware scans in AWS Backup

evidence.quote: **Expired baseline:** If your baseline recovery point was scanned more than 365 days ago, a full scan occurs. Because Amazon GuardDuty retains finding information for only 365 days, a new baseline must be established to ensure accurate scanning results.
